title: KOALA: Koopman Operator Learning for WiFi-Based Anticipatory Hum
abstract: arXiv:2608.15815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has emerged as a privacy-preserving alternative to cameras for human pose estimation. However, existing approaches treat pose inference as an instantaneous regression problem and do not model temporal dynamics, making future motion prediction infeasible. Naively applying vision-based prediction methods compounds the estimation noise already present in CSI-derived poses, as autoregressive rollouts amplify errors at every step. We propose KOALA, the framework for human motion prediction directly from WiFi CSI, by lifting noisy CSI-derived pose sequences into a learned Koopman latent space where nonlinear dynamics become linear, enabling multi-horizon prediction via simple matrix-vector products without autoregressive iteration or error accumulation. translated_title: KOALA：基于WiFi的预期人体动作预测的Koopman算子学习
translated_abstract: WiFi信道状态信息（CSI）已成为一种保护隐私的人体姿态估计替代方案，相比摄像头具有优势。然而，现有方法将姿态推断视为瞬时回归问题，不建模时间动态，使得未来动作预测不可行。天真地应用基于视觉的预测方法会加剧CSI派生姿态中已有的估计噪声，因为自回归滚动会在每一步放大误差。我们提出KOALA，一个直接从WiFi CSI进行人体动作预测的框架，通过将噪声CSI派生姿态序列提升到学习到的Koopman潜空间，在该空间中非线性动态变为线性，从而通过简单的矩阵-向量乘积实现多时间范围预测，无需自回归迭代或误差累积。一个残差CSI条件算子解决了Koopman公式中固有的恒等吸引子问题，一个锚点-增量预测头消除了...
tldr: 本文提出KOALA框架，利用Koopman算子将WiFi CSI姿态序列映射到线性潜空间，实现无误差累积的多时间范围人体动作预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes KOALA, a framework that maps WiFi CSI pose sequences into a linear latent space via Koopman operators, enabling multi-horizon human motion prediction without error accumulation.
